sources.observation: The dominant drum and ribbed copper dome are surrounded by smaller green cupolas and long glazed ridge lights.
Sandstone archivolts, clustered columns, repeated arched upper bays and the long sloped street awning define the east facade.

limitations: The canopy, window bays, dome ornament and estimated pavement grade follow exterior photos and PMTiles. Interior shops, passages and glazing are outside the model scope.
